name: approach_vs_static_paired
description: Paired ASNE contrast with matched wording for unchanged scenes versus another agent or object entering the observed area.

static_scene.text: A person watches the far end of a hallway. A delivery cart remains beside the storage door.
Someone looks across a quiet plaza. A cyclist waits beside the row of signs.
A person pauses near the lobby desk. A visitor stands by the glass entrance.
Someone watches the edge of a courtyard. A small service vehicle stays near the closed gate.

approaching_agent.text: A person watches the far end of a hallway. A delivery cart rolls out from the storage door.
Someone looks across a quiet plaza. A cyclist rides in from the row of signs.
A person pauses near the lobby desk. A visitor walks in through the glass entrance.
Someone watches the edge of a courtyard. A small service vehicle drives through the closed gate area.
